# Cover Flow

> Cover Flow (coverflow) is an open-source, iOS-style coverflow carousel component for React. It recreates the classic iTunes/iPhone Cover Flow interaction with real-time spring physics via Motion (Framer Motion), Tailwind CSS styling, and zero layout shift. It supports drag, touch, click-to-snap, horizontal scroll-wheel, and keyboard interactions, works with Next.js App Router and shadcn/ui conventions, and is MIT-licensed. Built by Ashish Gogula.

Install with the shadcn CLI:

    npx shadcn add https://ashishgogula.in/r/coverflow.json

Or from npm:

    npm install @ashishgogula/coverflow

## Docs

- [Get started](https://coverflow.ashishgogula.in/docs): installation (shadcn CLI, npm, pnpm, yarn, bun, manual), usage examples, live playground with presets, and the full props reference
- [Get started (raw MDX)](https://coverflow.ashishgogula.in/docs/get-started.mdx): the same documentation as plain text for language models
- [Changelog](https://coverflow.ashishgogula.in/changelog): release notes for every version
